workItems.title: [Report Designer] Support Discount Rate links
workItems.description:
As a Report Author
I want to link one or more cells to a Discount Rate slot and have the entered value drive discounting calculations for the report
So that I can set discount rate assumptions directly within the report template rather than configuring them elsewhere

Size estimate: TBD � shell created for estimation
Sequencing note: None

Requirements

Conceptual distinction from variable linking
Discount Rates (Discount Settings > Discount Rates) are not simple display/variable mappings � the linked cell is a live calculation input, not just a value pulled from an existing variable. This is distinct from the variable linking mechanism covered in 1869322.

Fixed slot ceiling
Discount Settings > Discount Rates offers a fixed ceiling of 5 named slots (Rate 1�5).

Many-or-few links per slot
Author can create as many or as few links as needed against any of the 5 slots, including multiple links to the same slot within a template.

Link value feeds calculation
Whatever value the Author types into a linked cell is used as the actual discount rate for that Rate 1�5 slot during report generation/calculation � not just displayed. Open question: Marg believes this is how it works (link the slot to a cell, then type the assumption value directly into that cell) but this mechanic is not yet confirmed � verify with engineering/UAT before finalizing AC.

comments.author: oleksandr.kruk@quorumsoftware.com
comments.text: • For desktop parity, the data flow is established: linked cells display rates from report options. The new cell-input scenario requires rules for conflicting cells, percentage formats, empty values, and precedence over report options.
